+@pytest.mark.parametrize('stream, level', [
+    ('stdout', usertypes.MessageLevel.info),
+    ('stderr', usertypes.MessageLevel.error),
+])
+def test_stream_output_live(proc, qtbot, caplog, message_mock, py_proc,
+                            stream, level):
+    """Output from either stream is shown before the process exits."""
+    proc._output_messages = True
+    cmd, args = py_proc(f"""
+        import sys, time
+        print('live text', file=sys.{stream}, flush=True)
+        time.sleep(0.5)
+    """)
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=5000):
+            proc.start(cmd, args)
+            qtbot.wait_until(lambda: bool(message_mock.messages), timeout=3000)
+            assert proc.outcome.running
+            assert message_mock.messages[0].level == level
+            assert message_mock.messages[0].text == 'live text'
+
+    assert [(msg.level, msg.text) for msg in message_mock.messages] == [
+        (level, 'live text'), (level, 'live text')]
+
+
